component.title: The literature correspondence: gandr's lineage and citation record

section.title: The correspondence record
section.prose: A literature correspondence is a one-line entry binding a gandr construct to the external categorical or type-theoretic line it descends from, is contrasted against, or is bounded by. This component is the standing home for the lineage and citation notes routed out of the internal-univalence feedback ledger under the owner's all-absorb decision: it records where a construct's design is authorized by, corrected against, or fenced by published work, kept apart from the technical components so a citation lands as one honest sentence rather than a re-derivation. It is a growing record — each correspondence lands when the track it annotates is next touched — so its status is partial by construction.

section.title: Lineage of the reflection face: the virtual line, not Ruit's
section.prose:
gandr's
— an inert reflection layer with no protype-composition primitive — descends from the virtual line : the Cruttwell–Shulman generalized multicategories that first presented the
by its units-and-restrictions universal property
, and the New–Licata VETT hyperdoctrine of virtual equipments
, with the Riehl–Verity §11.3 virtual-equipment presentation in the same pedigree. It is specifically not Ruit's multiple ∞-categories
, which are symmetric — every direction Segal-composes — so the composition primitive they carry is exactly the one the virtual line, and gandr's reflection face after it, deliberately withholds. internal-univalence made the same correction to its own design record on 2026-07-15.

section.title: The universe axis is not a Π-former
section.prose:
For a future "models of the conjectured type theory" story, the missing ingredient is not a fixed universe level. Ruit's α-power object
is a classifier — a free α-cocompletion — not a Π-former, so the universe axis instead wants a scale-as-ideal : a
class closed under ⊙ and restriction, together with a classifying protype. The tabularity half of that structure is already gandr's
and its comprehension. Honest note: the power-object axis is unfinished upstream too — the construction is Ruit's outlook, in a paper in preparation — and the scale-as-ideal axis is parked on the internal-univalence side.

section.title: The structure-univalence statement-shape precedent
section.prose:
Petrakis's univalent typoids
are the canonical MLTT-native statement-shape precedent for the faithfulness half of gandr's ua-base: structure-univalence — univalence-of-a-structure realized per type former as a J-only, axiom-free theorem (Def 4.1's round-trip map Ua : x≃y → x=y, with the closure theorems product Thm 4.7 and exponential Prop 5.1). It is a template and a vocabulary, not an import, under one load-bearing caveat: Def 4.1 targets the carrier's ambient identity type, which is degenerate over decidable codes — Hedberg's theorem makes that identity type propositional and collapses the proof-relevant ≃ — so the direction relevant to gandr is the typoid-function-as-equivalence (Rezk-completion) one the paper names but does not develop; no normal-form, decidability, or coherence machinery is inherited from it. This work is registered in the consolidated literature register (bibliography-v2 Q-20); this entry cites that registration rather than duplicating it.

section.title: Scope and non-goals
section.prose: The entries here are correspondences and lineage, never specifications: each records a relationship to external work, and the authoritative design for any construct remains in its technical component and the ADRs behind it. The record is partial by design — it carries the lineage and citation entries whose tracks have been touched, and further correspondences land as their tracks do. Where a routed source is not present in the consolidated literature register (for instance the Riehl–Verity virtual-equipment presentation named above), it appears as prose lineage rather than a formal citation, and its registration is a separate register decision.
